about: The free tasters (11 November 2026). Justin, 9 November: tasters free, full on Etsy. Each row is two or three pages of a paid pack, given for an email on guidedchildhood.com/free/<slug>; the full pack stays on Etsy and free inside the app. The Saturday post engine (Carousels, gc-weekly-promise) reads slug, title, ages, url and status, and rotates the live rows in this order. The site and scripts/build-tasters.mjs read the rest. status: live means the page and an Etsy listing are both live; no-listing means the page is live and the full pack is only in the app so far; hold means the page works by direct link but is not promoted: not on the /free index, not in the sitemap, not indexed, and not for the Saturday post (holdReason says why). inApp says the full pack is also free to print inside the app, so the emails and pages only offer that where it is true. Rebuild the PDFs with node scripts/build-tasters.mjs after changing pages or a listing.

tasters.title: The Christmas Screen Free Countdown
tasters.blurb: 24 days of something to do together, away from a screen. The taster is the tree poster and the first six doors.

pageNotes.b: One door a day, 1 to 24 December, with a Planet Friend on every one.
Pin it up, find today's door, do its card together, stick on its sticker.
The first six activity cards to cut out, from a paper chain to hot chocolate and a story.

tasters.title: Where Phones Sleep
tasters.blurb: Kitchen charging station signs, so every device in the house sleeps out of the bedroom. Yours goes first.

pageNotes.b: What is in the full pack: the station poster, the bedtime chart and the fridge pages.
One shelf in the kitchen, every device sleeps there, and why the grown ups go first.
The charging station sign itself, with the time everyone docks written in.

tasters.title: Earn Your Screen Time
tasters.blurb: A chart that turns screen time into a deal: earned first, agreed together, enjoyed in full. One star is five minutes.

pageNotes.b: The chart for 5 to 7s, the chart for 8 to 11s, and tokens to cut out.

pageNotes.h: Why it is not a bribe
pageNotes.b: You are not paying your child to behave. You are making a deal visible.
Pebble's chart: colour a star for every win, and earn the screen time together.

tasters.title: The First Phone Kit

Your child's side of the readiness check. Not yet is a good answer: it says what to practise next.

tasters.title: Screens at Granny's

pageNotes.b: A card for the grown ups, your child's deal card, a visit tally and thank you notes.

Yours every day, earned with stars, and resting time. Read it together before you go.

tasters.title: The Holiday Screen Deal

pageNotes.b: Our holiday deal, my daily core, the jobs board and the two week grid.
Holidays take away the shape of the day. This puts a simple one back.
Read it out loud, then both sign: the core time, the star rate and the protected times.

tasters.title: Say This: the script cards
tasters.blurb: The words for every screen moment. The taster is the list of all fifty moments and the first sheet of cards.

How to use the cards, and the first cards to cut out.
The words to say, printed on the back of each card.

tasters.title: The Star Swap Shop
tasters.blurb: Earn stars all week. On swap day, spend them on screen time, or on time with you.

pageNotes.b: Screen time, time together and the big save, all on one shop shelf.

pageNotes.h: One shelf, not the whole shop
pageNotes.b: Why a shop where screens are one choice beats a chart that only pays out in screens.
Pebble's chart: a star for every win, then swap them or save them up.

tasters.title: The Calm Down Corner Kit

A cosy spot you choose together, in a calm moment, before it is ever needed.

tasters.title: The Star Reward Chart

Write in the jobs you agreed, then colour a star each time one is done.
Tick the ones that fit your family and write your own on the blank rows.

tasters.title: The Family Phone Agreement

tasters.title: The Phone Under The Tree Treasure Hunt

tasters.title: The 30 Day Screen Reset Journal
tasters.ages: 8 and up, with the grown ups

pageNotes.b: Thirty small changes and five faces to colour each evening.
Nothing gets taken away for good and nobody is on trial.
Day zero: a snapshot of how things are now, so day thirty has something to look back at.

tasters.title: Are We Nearly There?

pageNotes.b: The journey deal card, car bingo for two ages, a map to colour, games and quests.

tasters.title: The Jobs Board for 11 to 15s

tasters.title: What Would You Do? Table Talk Cards
